summary: Zaiwen Wen’s current BICMR page describes mathematical formalization and integrated environments that connect modelling, algorithm design, computation, and verification. His 2026 M2F/Quokka work translates textbook-scale mathematical literature into machine-verified Lean projects with verifier-guided repair; Optlib is a Lean library for formalized mathematical optimization.
activity: Current official PI and group pages were generated 2026-10-06 and identify Zaiwen Wen as a BICMR professor with active PhD and postdoctoral members, including current PhD student Zichen Wang and postdoc Wanli Ma. The public M2F repository and associated 2026 paper describe project-scale mathematics-to-Lean formalization and verifier-guided proof repair; the Optlib repository provides ongoing machine-checked mathematical optimization formalization.

name: Zakhar Kogan — Sloppy Paper Checker
institution: Independent researcher-led project; institutional affiliation not established
summary: A maintained tool for reviewing scientific papers against explicit, study-type-specific methodology criteria. It links quoted evidence and provenance to assessments, exposes coverage gaps and limitations, separates evidence collection from assessment, and records methods and model context. This directly addresses how scientific claims and methods are evaluated, while the project explicitly states that its methodology is not yet a validated appraisal instrument.
activity: Four open issues opened by the repository owner on 2026-09-03 address current product and scoring work; repository also links the deployed application.

name: Zhang Qiangfeng Lab
